title: With rate limiting armed or on the REST door, a signed-in request still reads the session twice: give the request one shared session read (follow-up to #35457)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Filing gate: ① a measured defect, the half of #35457 its PR cannot reach inside its file surface. PR #35598 ("Part of #35457") makes the dispatcher's auth gate and the declared-endpoint fallback reuse the identity step's session read. Two more reads per request remain. Suggested grade: p1, because it is the rest of #35457, which objectstack-ai/cloud#4563 (p1, hosted page load 9–10 s) names as its blocker. ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets lane and grade.

## Measured (real kernel, sqlite-wasm, real AuthPlugin, Bearer session, warm; origin/main `97f342037d`; the os-dev report on #35457, comment 7016195995)

- **Inbound rate limiter.** With `server.security.rateLimit` armed, every request (dispatcher and REST) calls `getSession` once more. The caller is `packages/runtime/src/security/resolve-session-principal.ts:64`, reached from `dispatcher-plugin.ts:911` (the card's "near 217" is `readGatedSessionUser`, a different caller). The limiter runs in the transport's middleware seam. The Hono adapter runs the whole IHttp middleware chain to completion, and only then calls the route, with a separate request object and no shared async scope. So `packages/runtime` cannot hand the limiter's read to the route without a cross-request cache, which is ruled out.
- **REST door with an ADR-0069 gate active.** `GET /api/v1/data/<object>` issues 2 `getSession` calls: the identity read, plus core `decideAuthGate` under `authGate: 'reread-when-active'` (`packages/core/src/security/request-execution-context.ts:226`, used by `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:3484`). That is 2 `sys_session` token lookups per REST request.
- On remote Turso every read is a round trip, so each extra read adds one per request on hosted.

## Done when

One request reads the session and its user once on every door (dispatcher, REST, declared endpoints), with the rate limiter armed and with a session gate active. A real-kernel test pins the count for each door and posture. Nothing is cached across requests, and revocation, expiry, held-session (403) and anonymous (401) behave as today.

## Direction (the dev's recommendation, to be designed on this card)

A core-owned per-request session-read memo, in the shape of the existing request-grants memo: the transport opens it per request, and core `readSession`, `decideAuthGate` and the runtime limiter consult it. One carrier fixes all three doors. The narrower alternative, one async scope across the Hono middleware seam and the route, fixes only the limiter-to-dispatcher pair and leaves REST at 2. Surface: `packages/core/src/security/**`, the Hono server plugin's middleware seam, `packages/runtime/src/security/resolve-session-principal.ts`, `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (consumer only).

Dedupe: issue search `rate limit getSession`, `reread-when-active`, `session read once request scope`, `limiter session read` → only #35457.
